brief:
International reviewers have hailed the award-winning documentary NAZA as "brilliant and harrowing" and "impossible to ignore," The Guardian reported. The film features interviews with military insiders discussing the mass killing of civilians in Gaza and has garnered widespread critical acclaim across the globe.

The documentary presents firsthand accounts from those involved in the conflict, with critics describing it as both difficult to watch and essential viewing.
dek: Film interviewing military insiders about mass killing of civilians in Gaza wins widespread praise around the world Critics around the world have hailed the award-winning documentary NAZA as a “brilliant and harrowing” film that is “impossible to ignore”.
title: Critics worldwide praise NAZA documentary on Gaza civilian killings
